import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Semaphore;
final class WorkerSignalSerializableCanary extends Semaphore {
  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
  private final transient CountDownLatch waiting = new CountDownLatch(1);
  private transient Runnable callback = () -> {};
  WorkerSignalSerializableCanary() { super(0); }
}
